scope: Read-only native guest stack diagnostics; no CPU execution or memory semantics changed.
finding: Win98 USER.EXE executes with a nonflat 16-bit SS. The previous diagnostic treated stale high ESP bits as a flat linear address. Such samples cannot identify a valid Win16 stack.
fix: Use SS base plus SP for16-bit stacks, full ESP for32-bit stacks; stop at width/linear wrap boundaries. Record sampled SS selector/base/width. Optional absent fields retain the existing flat32 test caller convention.

validation.red: New segmented16-bit assertion fails with the old reader.
validation.green: All absent-page,4KiB,PSE,PAE,unaligned,CR2/A-D preservation controls plus nonflat16/32-bit,stale highESP and wrap controls pass. Harness syntax passes.

limits: This corrects the diagnostic only. Current Win9803 GT2 loading wait is not thereby diagnosed or fixed.
Earlier Win16 stack interpretations using flat ESP are not acceptance evidence.
